# Contributing

Thanks for the interest in this project. This is the default guide for repositories owned by
[Lightbridge-KS](https://github.com/Lightbridge-KS); a repository with a `CONTRIBUTING.md` of its
own follows that one instead.

## Issues

- Search the existing issues first — a comment on an open issue beats a duplicate.
- **Bugs:** the smallest example that still fails is worth more than a long description. Include
  versions and the full error message.
- **Features:** start from the problem and a concrete use case, then the proposal.

## Pull requests

- For anything beyond a small fix, open an issue first, so the approach is agreed before the work
  is done.
- One topic per PR. Follow the style of the surrounding code, and add or update tests where the
  project has them.
- Commit messages and PR titles follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
  — for example `fix(parser): handle empty input`.

## Writing PR descriptions and commit messages

PR descriptions and commit messages are the project's durable record, read by people who were not
there when the work was done. These rules apply equally to people and to AI coding agents:

- **Impersonal.** No "you" / "I", no narrative of how the work went — state what is true now.
- **Roles, not names.** "maintainer", "reviewer"; reach a specific person through Assignees,
  Reviewers, or an @-mention.
- **Evidence over inference.** Write `Unknown` rather than a plausible guess, and keep *verified*
  apart from *not verified*.
- **Nothing private.** No secrets or tokens, no personal or sensitive data, no personal file paths
  or machine names. Describe an environment so that anyone can rebuild it.
